# Vendor data on a fixture destination's ranking of link posts

## Statement
Vendor data associates a link in the body of a post on this fixture
destination with lower reach than the same post without it.

## Applies when
always

## Influences
- S-10 · `E-14.cross_destination_link` — where the cross-destination link goes.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture record for the Knowledge Maintenance job: platform knowledge whose
review lapsed months ago, so that §5's demotion has something to be read from.
